title: Drop private imports from test_urlparse.py
description:
More towards #2492

We still access `._uri_reference`, because the goal of this module is to test our vendored `urlparse()` implementation, but at least we do so from `httpx.URL()`.
patch_diff:
diff --git a/httpx/_urlparse.py b/httpx/_urlparse.py
index ac1c6271bc..0fbec3584a 100644
--- a/httpx/_urlparse.py
+++ b/httpx/_urlparse.py
@@ -195,18 +195,6 @@ def urlparse(url: str = "", **kwargs: typing.Optional[str]) -> ParseResult:
     # -------------------------------------------------------------
 
     for key, value in kwargs.items():
-        if key not in (
-            "scheme",
-            "authority",
-            "path",
-            "query",
-            "fragment",
-            "userinfo",
-            "host",
-            "port",
-        ):
-            raise TypeError(f"'{key}' is an invalid keyword argument for urlparse()")
-
         if value is not None:
             if len(value) > MAX_URL_LENGTH:
                 raise InvalidURL(f"URL component '{key}' too long")
